title: 25 mm box-X bartack proof at the BL-010 per-row loads
gates: every 25 mm box-X on IM1-IM3 and US1/US2
steps: sew 10 loops exactly like the pack; loop over the 5 mm pin; 5 loops to 908 N (92.6 kg) and 5 to 1080 N (110.1 kg); hold 1 min each
pass: 5 of 5 hold 908 N (IM) and 5 of 5 hold 1080 N (US) for 1 min, no broken stitch

title: meat-strap hook proof per strap (BL-010)
steps: as PT-1: G-hooks to 645 N (65.7 kg, covers IM1 410 N), carabiners to 910 N (92.8 kg); hold 1 min
pass: 5 of 5 G-hooks hold 645 N and 5 of 5 carabiners hold 910 N for 1 min, gates close

title: 25 mm cam buckle slip at the BL-010 per-row loads, dry, wet and cold
steps: thread the cam as in the pack; paint-pen mark at the cam mouth. DRY: pull to 908 N (92.6 kg), hold 1 min, measure; then to 1080 N (110.1 kg), hold 1 min, measure. WET: fresh webbing, cam + webbing soaked 10 min, same two holds. COLD: fresh webbing, 2 h in the freezer (record -20 C; write the freezer reading), pull within 2 min of taking it out, same two holds
pass: mark moves < 3 mm at 908 N and at 1080 N, 5 of 5, in each of dry / wet / cold

title: IM3 bag carabiner on the sewn T3 tongue, per-row proof (BL-010)
steps: carabiner over the 5 mm steel pin; sewn T3 tongue on the carabiner; pull with the come-along to 2553 N (260.2 kg on the scale); hold 60 s; release; check the gate closes and look for set
pass: 5 of 5 hold 2553 N for 60 s, gate closes after, no visible set

title: T3 tongue on the 70 mm B-17 tab on a B-01 swatch (BL-010 load)
gates: T3 on the 70 mm B-17 tab
steps: clamp the B-01 swatch 120 mm wide between bar clamps; tongue loop on the pin; pull to 2553 N (260.2 kg); hold 60 s
pass: 5 of 5 hold 2553 N, no stitch break, no laminate tear

title: HE hinge eye on B-18 + B-01 + B-05 floor seam, sewn as op 4.05 (DECISION HE-ONE), no binding
steps: 5 mm pin through the eye; clamp the B-05 strip in one bar clamp and the B-01 top edge in the other so the pull runs up B-01 (the bag-on direction); pull to 1530 N (156.0 kg); hold 60 s
pass: 5 of 5 hold 1530 N 60 s: no stitch break, no Hypalon or laminate tear, B-18 still in the floor seam

title: guy ladder lock + tri-glide keeper slip
steps: mark webbing; 10 cycles 0 -> 170 N -> 0 by hand on the come-along; measure the mark
pass: slip < 5 mm over 10 cycles

title: B-24 float stand-off link
steps: link hook on the pin; 38 mm loop through the 220 mm loop; pull in line to 1410 N; hold 60 s
pass: 5 of 5 hold 1410 N, no box-X break, gate closes

title: heavy 25 mm ladder lock slip at 432 N, dry, wet and cold (guys, W1-W3, B-28)
gates: heavy 25 mm ladder lock slip at 432 N (1.5 x 288 N), dry, wet and -20 C: guys, W1-W3 and the B-28 crown straps (the B-28 slip gate since BL-031)
steps: thread as in the pack; paint-pen mark at the lock. DRY (room temperature): hang 44.0 kg (432 N, sand bags) 50 mm above the floor for 1 h, all 5 side by side; measure the mark. WET: re-thread on fresh webbing, soak lock + webbing 10 min in water, hang the same load wet for 1 h. COLD: re-thread on fresh webbing, 2 h in the freezer (record -20 C; a home freezer holds about -18 C: write the reading), load within 2 min of taking it out, hold 10 min
pass: slip < 5 mm, 5 of 5, in each of dry / wet / cold at 432 N (covers the W 338 N proof); a fail in any condition: tell the pack-designer (record fallbacks: aluminium ladderlock)

title: box-X fatigue on the lever rig: 25 mm box-X loops, 1e5 cycles 38 -> 384 N (R 0.1)
gates: box-X fatigue (ASSUMPTION SEW_FAT 0.40 x box strength): IM end loops (S1), US eyes (S6), belt tabs (H1)
steps: loop over a 5 mm pin on the lever (in place of a coupon), the free end in the bar clamp; set the crank so the cell swings 10 -> 96 N (4:1 lever = 38 -> 384 N on the loop); 1 Hz to 100,000 cycles (27.8 h); loupe check at 25,000 / 50,000 / 75,000; after run-out pull the loop on the G2 bench to 1080 N (the MT-1 US proof), 1 min
pass: 3 of 3 run-outs to 1e5 at 384 N, no broken stitch, then hold 1080 N 1 min (a 2 of 3 result: run 3 more, pass with 5 of 6)

title: loaded CG (+ 15 in, 30 kg meat check); CORRIE F rev 3 items in rows T9-R3a..d (BL-038 split)
gates: loaded CG on the first article (rev C basis); its rev 3 items are the T9-R3a..d rows below (BL-038 split)
steps: 68 kg fill and meat on IM1-IM3 at 15/19/23 in; hang from haul loop, then from a hip pin, plumb both lines; add 30 kg on IM1-IM3 at 15 in; then rows T9-R3a (port guys, S kit CG), T9-R3c (crown strap path) in the same session; T9-R3b (cinch after a walk) and T9-R3d (lid) after T1-T4
pass: bag CG <= 205 mm at z <= 590; meat <= 190; tall <= 185; rev 3 items: rows T9-R3a..d

title: T9 rev 3 (a): port guys hold the S-kit top, meat CG at 15 in
gates: rev 3 (a): B-27 port guys hold the S-kit top, CG at the S kit (BL-030)
steps: top packed full above the guys; 30 kg sand meat on IM1-IM3, fill to 68 kg; hang from the haul loop and plumb a line; hang from a pin through the hip pivot and plumb a second line; the CG is where the lines cross; measure its distance aft of the stay plane
pass: meat CG <= 190 mm aft (record against 179.3 mm)

title: T9 rev 3 (b): crown strap cinch force and retention (CROWN_PRE_N, MU_LID)
gates: rev 3 (b): B-28 crown strap cinch force and retention
steps: hook the spring scale on each B-28 tail; pull to 8.2 kg (80 N) and lock; walk 30 min loaded (only after T1-T4 pass); read the tension again (pull the tail until it just moves); set the pack down hard from 0.5 m on its base; read again; check the lid is still seated
pass: after the walk >= 40 N, or the lid still seated on the full top (report both values)

title: T9 rev 3 (c): crown strap free length (ROLL-PATH, TORSO-LIN)
gates: rev 3 (c): B-28 crown strap free length per crown kit (cut = longest path + 40 mm spare + 2 grips, BL-039)
steps: cinch both crown straps; measure the strap path from the bar tab to the ladder lock along the strap with a tape (both straps); repeat at the L kit 6-day setting
pass: S kit full: path <= 968.1 mm (cut 1068.1 - 2 x 50 mm grip tail; sim 928.1 mm); L kit 6-day: record against the sim's 438.8 mm

title: T9 rev 3 (d): sewn lid mass and seat (LID_SLIDER5_G, LID_THREAD, LID-SEAT)
gates: rev 3 (d): sewn B-29 lid mass and seat
steps: weigh the lid alone 3 times; photograph it seated on the packed 6-day bag and the full bag, from the rear 3/4 and the side
pass: lid 47.8 g +/- 5 g (ledger); lid edge on the hinge-band seam, camo caps over the blades

title: ULTRA 200X 50 mm strip tensile (C-5 / O-5)
gates: alternate fabric gate: ULTRA 200X 50 mm strip (floor / frame side)
steps: clamp each strip in the 50 mm bar grips, 200 mm gauge; pull slowly to break; record the peak
pass: mean >= 1840 N/50 mm, minimum >= 1195 N/50 mm
